note: 13 Nov (the owner: new lessons for the new protocol, plus style sets, plus data for surgery). GPT-OSS 120B (stock, ggml-org MXFP4) writes a Bob distillation set (3,000 over 26 jobs incl. the step-by-step ones: codefix, recover, clarify, selfcheck, research, newtool, understand; half thinking) and four style sets (400 each: Sherlock, Watson, Vulcan, Raider; each its OWN set for its OWN model, plain Bob prompt saved, style text to the writer only, no tag), every answer reviewed and saved with GPT-OSS's own odds (top 8 per word). Then three brains READ the new lessons with Brain Engine's expert trace (nothing written): GPT-OSS 120B, its 38B cut and Riker, each giving per-job and per-style expert maps measured on itself, plus dial trials for expert-sweep.mjs. Last, the 120B map is checked against the 38B's own (keep-32-v2). Lessons and odds stay on the PC: clean-lessons.mjs, scrub, then Hugging Face only on the owner's word. About 4-4.5 h on one H200 (~$21-24); caps 6 h / $32.

benchmark.note: one brain at a time; the writer first (32 lessons at once share one copy of the weights), then the three readers (one lesson at a time: the expert trace is one stream per server)
